description: Per-call CDR detail: start time, ANI/DNIS, customer trunk, SIP code, release reason, billed prefix, state and rate center. Includes SIP reason percentage breakdown.

panels.description: Per customer trunk AND termination state: SIP reason breakdown with the raw billed-prefix Codes (e.g. 1304522) shown per code. '% of Cust+State' = share of that customer+state's attempts. Customers with no traffic in a state appear as a single 0% '(no traffic)' row so coverage gaps are visible. Heavy unfiltered (per-code grain, 24h ~14M rows); select a Customer Trunk to make it fast. Respects CDR Source and Customer Trunk filters; ignores SIP Code filter.

targets.rawSql: WITH custs AS (SELECT DISTINCT orig_trunk_group_name AS cust FROM cdr.sip_reason_cust_state_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND orig_trunk_group_name != '(none)' AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk)), sts AS (SELECT DISTINCT term_state AS st FROM cdr.sip_reason_cust_state_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND notEmpty(term_state) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity)), actual AS (SELECT orig_trunk_group_name AS cust, term_state AS st, if(notEmpty(billed_prefix), billed_prefix, '—') AS code, concat(toString(sip_code),' - ',reason) AS rsn, sum(attempts) AS att FROM cdr.sip_reason_cust_state_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND notEmpty(term_state) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) GROUP BY cust, st, code, rsn), tot AS (SELECT cust, st, sum(att) AS t FROM actual GROUP BY cust, st) SELECT g.cust AS `Customer Trunk`, g.st AS `State`, if(a.att=0,'—',a.code) AS `Codes`, if(a.att=0,'(no traffic)',a.rsn) AS `SIP Reason`, a.att AS `Attempts`, if(tot.t=0, 0, round(100.0*a.att/tot.t,2)) AS `% of Cust+State` FROM (SELECT cust, st FROM custs CROSS JOIN sts) g LEFT JOIN actual a ON g.cust=a.cust AND g.st=a.st LEFT JOIN tot ON g.cust=tot.cust AND g.st=tot.st ORDER BY `Attempts` DESC LIMIT 5000

panels.title: SIP Reason by Customer & State

panels.description: One row per CDR leg in the selected time range. Filter by CDR source, customer trunk and SIP code above.

targets.rawSql: SELECT call_start_time AS `Start Time`, from_did AS `ANI`, to_did AS `DNIS`, orig_trunk_group_name AS `Customer Trunk`, sip_code AS `SIP Code`, coalesce(nullIf(reason, ''), nullIf(sip_reason, ''), 'Not provided') AS `Release Reason`, if(billed_prefix = '', '?', billed_prefix) AS `Billed Prefix`, term_state AS `State`, term_ratecenter AS `Rate Center`, entity AS `CDR Source`, callid AS `Call ID` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(toString(sip_code) = ${sip_code:singlequote}, $sip_code) ORDER BY event_time DESC, record_key LIMIT 10000

panels.title: CDR Detail (latest 10,000)
Rural Code Traffic (latest ${rural_row_limit})
panels.description: Calls whose billed prefix (NPA-NXX) appears in the rural prefix list (cdr.rural_prefix_list). Follows the dashboard time range and the CDR source / customer trunk / SIP code filters above. Export via the panel menu: Inspect > Data > Download CSV.

targets.rawSql: SELECT call_start_time AS `Start Time`, from_did AS `ANI`, to_did AS `DNIS`, billed_prefix AS `Rural Code`, orig_trunk_group_name AS `Customer Trunk`, orig_carrier_name AS `Customer Carrier`, term_carrier_name AS `Termination Vendor`, term_trunk_group_name AS `Termination Trunk`, entity AS `CDR Source`, sip_code AS `SIP Code`, if(sip_code = 200, 'Answered', 'Failed') AS `Result`, coalesce(nullIf(reason, ''), nullIf(sip_reason, ''), 'Not provided') AS `Release Reason`, duration_real AS `Duration Sec`, term_state AS `State`, term_ratecenter AS `Rate Center`, callid AS `Call ID` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND billed_prefix IN (SELECT billed_prefix FROM cdr.rural_prefix_list) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(toString(sip_code) = ${sip_code:singlequote}, $sip_code) AND record_key IN (SELECT record_key FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND billed_prefix IN (SELECT billed_prefix FROM cdr.rural_prefix_list) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) AND $__conditionalAll(toString(sip_code) = ${sip_code:singlequote}, $sip_code) ORDER BY event_time DESC, record_key LIMIT ${rural_row_limit}) ORDER BY event_time DESC, record_key

panels.title: Looping ANI + DNIS across entities (latest ${loop_row_limit})
panels.description: Same ANI and DNIS seen on more than one entity inside a short window - the call left one entity and re-entered the network through another instead of terminating. One row per ANI+DNIS pair, worst first by leg count. Tune with the Loop: variables above. Export via the panel menu: Inspect > Data > Download CSV.

targets.rawSql: WITH hits AS ( SELECT cityHash64(from_did, to_did) AS pair_hash FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND notEmpty(from_did) AND notEmpty(to_did) AND $__conditionalAll(entity = ${entity:singlequote}, $entity) AND $__conditionalAll(orig_trunk_group_name = ${origin_trunk:singlequote}, $origin_trunk) GROUP BY pair_hash HAVING uniqUpTo(4)(entity) >= ${loop_min_entities} AND count() >= ${loop_min_legs} AND max(event_time) - min(event_time) <= ${loop_window_sec} ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT ${loop_row_limit}) SELECT from_did AS `ANI`, to_did AS `DNIS`, uniqExact(entity) AS `Entities`, arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupUniqArray(entity)), ', ') AS `Entity List`, count() AS `Legs`, countIf(sip_code = 200) AS `Answered`, max(event_time) - min(event_time) AS `Span Sec`, uniqExact(orig_trunk_group_name) AS `Cust Trunks`, uniqExact(term_carrier_name) AS `Term Vendors`, min(event_time) AS `First Seen`, max(event_time) AS `Last Seen` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND notEmpty(from_did) AND notEmpty(to_did) AND cityHash64(from_did, to_did) IN (SELECT pair_hash FROM hits) GROUP BY from_did, to_did HAVING uniqExact(entity) >= ${loop_min_entities} ORDER BY `Legs` DESC LIMIT ${loop_row_limit}

list.description: Row cap for the Rural Code Traffic table.

list.name: loop_min_entities
list.label: Loop: min entities
list.description: A pair must appear on at least this many entities to count as a loop. 2 means the same ANI+DNIS was seen on one entity and then another.

list.name: loop_min_legs
list.label: Loop: min legs
list.description: Minimum call legs for the pair. Filters ordinary retries from genuine loops.

list.name: loop_window_sec
list.label: Loop: window (sec)
list.description: All legs must fall within this many seconds. A routing loop re-enters the network almost immediately.

list.name: loop_row_limit
list.label: Loop: max rows
list.description: Row cap for the Loop Detection table.
